mapper.select:
SELECT e.category_code AS category_code, c.label AS category_label, SUM(e.amount) AS amount FROM expenses e JOIN trip_members tm ON e.payer_member_id = tm.id JOIN expense_categories c ON e.category_code = c.code WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trips t WHERE t.id=e.trip_id AND t.currency='KRW')
AND e.spent_at >= #{from}
AND e.spent_at < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY e.category_code, c.label, c.sort_order ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expenses ( trip_id, category_code, payer_member_id, name, memo, amount, source, spent_at ) VALUES ( #{tripId}, #{categoryCode}, #{payerMemberId}, #{name}, #{memo}, #{amount}, #{source}, #{spentAt} )

INSERT INTO split_details (expense_id, member_name, amount, percent) VALUES
(#{d.expenseId}, #{d.memberName}, #{d.amount}, #{d.percent})
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, DATE_FORMAT(e.spent_at, '%m월 %d일') AS dateLabel, '💳' AS emoji, e.name, e.payer_member_id AS payerMemberId, e.category_code AS categoryCode, tm.display_name AS payerName, '균등분할' AS splitLabel, e.amount, e.amount AS myShare, e.memo FROM expenses e JOIN trip_members tm ON tm.id = e.payer_member_id WHERE e.trip_id = #{tripId} ORDER BY e.spent_at DESC, e.id DESC
SELECT id, name, emoji, amount, payer_name AS payerName, split_mode AS splitMode, DATE_FORMAT(spent_at, '%m월 %d일 %H:%i') AS dateLabel, memo FROM expenses WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT member_name AS memberName, amount, percent FROM split_details WHERE expense_id = #{expenseId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM expenses WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT e.id, DATE_FORMAT(e.spent_at, '%m월 %d일') AS dateLabel, '💳' AS emoji, e.name, tm.display_name AS payerName, '균등분할' AS splitLabel, e.amount, e.amount AS myShare, e.memo FROM expenses e JOIN trip_members tm ON tm.id = e.payer_member_id WHERE e.trip_id = #{tripId} AND e.id = #{expenseId}
